source.publication: Taxes (individuals), South Dakota Department of Revenue
source.section: 'Income Tax' heading, first sentence: South Dakota has no personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 60,000.00 + interest 500.00 = 60,500.00. Federal taxable income = 60,500.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 44,750.00 (given, not tested). South Dakota imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
